subject: 68 days later, a thank you
preview_text: You've been with us for 68 days. Here's something only long-term users get.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago, you hit download on Smart Notes. That was the first step. Since then, you've been turning chaotic meetings into clear next steps, saving hours you used to waste rewriting notes. I've seen the data — users like you who stick around are the ones who never miss a key point again. This email is my personal thank you for trusting us with your time.

Here's the thing: most people try the app once and drift away. But you didn't. You're part of the small group who gets how much clarity matters after a call. So I'm giving you something exclusive — early access to our Premium feature: structured summaries with custom meeting language controls. It's designed for founders, students, and teams who need transcripts that actually speak their language. You've earned it by being a loyal user.

Open the app, tap on any recent meeting, and hit 'Language-Aware Summary.' It detects the meeting's language and outputs key points and action items in that same language — no more guessing. This isn't in the standard flow; it's a perk for users like you who've been with us for over two months. It's our way of saying thanks for sticking around.

Open Smart Notes now and try the Language-Aware Summary on your last recording. One tap, and you'll see what I mean. P.S. The 'Shareable Notes' feature is also unlocked for you — send summaries to your team with one tap. No more lost action items.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
